G=load(); import json
ti=G['Test input']; di=G['Demo pair 1 input']; do=G['Demo pair 1 output']

def solve(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); out=[row[:] for row in g]
    seen=set()
    def comps():
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                v=g[r][c]
                if v not in (0,8) and (r,c) not in seen:
                    stack=[(r,c)]; comp=[]
                    while stack:
                        y,x=stack.pop()
                        if (y,x) in seen or g[y][x] in (0,8): continue
                        seen.add((y,x)); comp.append((y,x))
                        for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                            ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                            if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w: stack.append((ny,nx))
                    yield comp
    for comp in comps():
        rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        # expand region rect over non-8 cells
        rt,rb,cl,cr=r0,r1,c0,c1
        while rt>0 and all(g[rt-1][c]!=8 for c in range(cl,cr+1)): rt-=1
        while rb<h-1 and all(g[rb+1][c]!=8 for c in range(cl,cr+1)): rb+=1
        while cl>0 and all(g[r][cl-1]!=8 for r in range(rt,rb+1)): cl-=1
        while cr<w-1 and all(g[r][cr+1]!=8 for r in range(rt,rb+1)): cr+=1
        th,tw=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
        pat=[[g[r0+i][c0+j] for j in range(tw)] for i in range(th)]
        for r in range(rt,rb+1):
            for c in range(cl,cr+1):
                out[r][c]=pat[(r-r0)%th][(c-c0)%tw]
    return out

print(json.dumps(res))
